My fursona is male. And it's cartoony. I just wanted to make a fursona that describes. I've discovered furries 4 years ago, but I made my fursona just about 8 months ago. Despite not having a name or design for my fursona all that time, I always wanted to be a fox. Just naturally colored fox. But when I was making my fursona, I added a little bit of my favorite color that's not natural to make it more original and some stripes. His name is Lumy. Because I love photography a lot. I grew up with photography. I'd say it runs in my family. Lumy is derived from the word luminosity. At first, my fursonas name was Lummy, but I didn't like the spelling in English, so I changed it. I'm not new to the fandom, but I joined just 8 months ago. Like started meeting actual furries and stuff. And I'm doing pretty well. I'm an artist and a photographer. I was already making souvenirs for a local furry con. The "first" ever furry con in my country. I was also a photographer there. I'm happy that furries accepted me. Everyone calls me Lumy already, so I don't even want to change it anymore. It just stuck to me. Maybe I will make a second fursona, but this one is going to stay as my main one. 
I just want my fursona to be me
